description: Lyle McDonald's flexible dieting method: diet category from sex and body fat, refeed length, frequency and carbohydrate grams (per lb of lean mass), weeks of dieting before a 10–14 day full diet break at maintenance, and whether the break is due. Published averages, not individual prescriptions; not for eating disorders, pregnancy or under-18s.

training.description: hard = real weight training 2–3+ times a week for about an hour, or long/hard endurance; light = light exercise or none.

weeks_dieting.description: Weeks dieted since the start or the last full break.
